text: Shin medheta asi koyro yin, guyepe ayyaana asi yisipe attishin, ayyaana asi koyro yibeenna.
Iyorbaami Gibxefe simmidaysa Isra7eele asa ubbay si7ida wode iya banta maabaraako xeegidi Isra7eele bolla kawothidosona. Dawita kochaafe kawotida kawotas ammanetiday Yihuda kochaa xalaala.
Phawuloosi Sillaaseynne Ximotiyoosi Teselonqe woosa keethan de7iya, Xoossaa Aawabanne Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosaba gidida asaas xaafida kiita. Aadho keehatethaynne saroy hintew gido.
Akaazi Xoossa keetha miisheta ubbaa shiishidi tincherethis. Xoossa keethaa pengeta gordis. Yerusalaamen dumma dumma bessan baw yarsho bessi keexis.
Hinte iitabaa oothonna mela nuuni Xoossaa woossoos. Nuuni mino gideysa asay be7ana mela gidonashin, nuuni mino gidonna ixikoka, hinte lo77o oothana mela nuuni woossoos.
Iya aylleti gaariyan iya ekidi, Yerusalaame efidosona; iya mayzata matan Dawita Kataman moogidosona.

Ayis giiko, ha deriya wozanay muumis; enta haythay tullis; enta ayfeyka goozetis. Hessi bayneko, enti banta ayfiyan be7idi, banta haythan si7idi, banta wozanan akeekidi, taako simmanashin; taka enta pathanashin’ yaaga” yaagis.
Katama giddon ola moyzey punetiya wode asay yashshan kokoreneyee? Woyko Goday kiittonna de7ishin dhayoy issi katama bolla yiiyee?
Babiloone cincati ubbay iya sinthe yidosna; shin entafe oonika he xuufiya nabbabanaw woyko iya birshethaa odanaw danda7ibeenna.
Adde gidin woyko maccas gidin, laymatethan demmida miishe qaangethi gathanaw Godaa ne Xoossaa keethi ehopo. Enta nam7aa Goday ne Xoossay ixees.
Goday nena ne morketan xoonisana. Neeni enta olanaw issi ogera keyana; shin laapun ogera ne enta sinthafe baqatana. Biittan de7iya kawotethi ubbay ne bolla gakidaba be7idi, yashshan kokorana.
Taani taako, “Haaya, ta nena ufaysi aybeko erisanaw lo7oba bessaana” yaagas; shin hessika hada.
Hessika, taani hachi gakanaw koyada demmaboonnaba. Mukulu adde asa giddofe bonchoy bessiya issi adde xalaala demmas; shin macca asaa giddofe issinnoka demmanaw danda7abike.
Asay shaara tuussa Dunkaaniya pengiyan be7ida wode ubban, ba pengen pengen gulbatidi Godaas goyinnoosona.
Enta qoncethaynne enta bitay wordo. Enti Goday kiittonnashin, Goday haysada yaagees yaagosona. Enti odeysa Goday polana gidi naagoosona.

Hessa gisho, hinte mino gidana mela, he biitta ayfiya maana melanne merinaw hinte naytas laatisana mela, hinte macca nayta enta adde naytas immofite; enta macca nayta hinte adde naytas ekofite. Enti sarotethaninne duretethan daana mela amottofite’ yaagadasa.
Shin ammanoy yaanape kase higgey nuna qachi wothis. He ammanoy qoncana gakanaw higgey nu bolla gordi wothis.
Xoossay entana, “Yeletite, darite, sa7a kumite; haarite. Abba molo, salo kafotanne biitta bolla woxi qaaxiya, de7oy de7iya medhetetha ubbaa haarite” yaagidi anjis.
ne tana ta aawa soo saro zaariko, ne ta Xoossa gidana.
Hari attoshin, koyro caaqoyka suuthi bayna minnibeenna.
Taani beniysada ne halaqata, koyroysada ne zoranchota denthana. Hessafe guye, neeni ammanetida biitta; xillotetha Katama geetetana” yaagees.
Galima asaw, waaso goochite! Laysha asaw, si7ite! Anatoota asaw, oysha zaarite!
Taani Asoore asaa ta biittan mentherethana; ta deriya bolla iya yedhana. Iya qambaray enta bollafe, iya toohoy enta hashiyape kichana” yaagis.
Dagama gaason enta mino miixay laaletana; enta toora moconati dagammidi yeggi dhayana” yaagees, iya tamay Xiyoonen, iya coocey Yerusalaamen de7iya Goday.

Enti iita hargen hayqana; entaw yeekiya woyko enta moogiya asi bentenna. Enta ahay biitta bolla pito mela yegetana; enti mashshaninne koshan wurana; enta ashoy salo kafotasinne sa7a do7atas kathi gidana” yaagis.
Nu Xoossa keethay koyrope doomidi, boncho kawotetha araatada dhoqa deriya bolla de7ees.
“Taani Isra7eele asaasinne Yihuda asaas gelida qaala poliya wodey yaana.
Yihudi heedzu woyko oyddu bessata nabbabidaape guye, kawoy he bessata xaatha maxaafape mashshan qanxi qanxidi, taman yeggis; hessada oothidi, maxaafa kumethi xuuggis.
He wode Ermiyaasi ba gisho biitta ekanaw Biniyaame biitta baanaw Yerusalaamepe dendis.
Shin ha77i hinte gita katamay yeellatananne kawuyana. Kawotethata giddon Babilooney ubbaafe laafa gidana; haathi bayna mela biitta gidana.
Yaatin, asi Xoossaa sinthan xillo gidanaw danda7ii? Maccasape yeletida asi geeshshi gidanaw danda7ii?
Hessi pirda ehiya nagara gidiya gisho Xoossaa kaddas guussu.
Ta paxa de7ishin tana ollan yeggidi, ollaa doona shuchan gordidosona.
Mashshan wodheysati bazzon de7iya gisho, nu shempuwa bayzidi kathi demmida.
Kahiney he katha yarshuwa ekidi, yarsho bessan xuussa yarsho oothidi taman xuuggo. Hessi Godaas taman xuugetiya sawo tonku giya qofiso yarsho gidana.
Hessafe guye, kahiney nam7u kafotape issuwa pultofe duuqidi keren qolida haatha bolla shukana mela kiitto.

Laapun gallas ubban Godaas xuussa yarsho shiishite; hospuntho gallasan geeshsha shiiqo shiiqite. Godaas xuussa katha yarsho shiishite. He gallasay baaliya wursetha gallas gidiya gisho, ooso oothopite.
“Godaa Yesuusa, nuus qadhetarki” yaagidi waassidosona.
Yesuusi Herodiisa biittafe yida asi gideysa Philaxoosi erida wode Herodiisi he wode Yerusalaamen de7iya gisho iyako yeddis.
He biittan de7iya asay Yesuusa erida wode banta heeran de7iya guta ubba kiita yeddidosona. Asay harganchota ubbaa iyako ehidosona.
“He wode haddirsa baggara de7eysatako, ‘Ha baadetidaysato, ta matape haakite. Xalahesinne iya kiitanchotas giigida merinaa taman biite.
Neeni nu mayzata Gibxe biittan gakida un7aa be7adasa; qassi Zo7o Abbaa matan de7ishe enti waassida waasuwa si7adasa.
Tana be7iya ubbay qelqisoosona; banta huuphiya qaathishe dereeqosona.
Asi baw maata mela; I bazzo ciishshada ciyees.
sakana dhumi new dhumenna; qammi gallasada poo7ees; new dhumi poo7o mela.
I ne pengiya kobeta minthana; ne giddon de7iya ne asaa anjana.
Ta ishato, taani Ayhude gidonna asaape ayfe demmidaysada, hintefeka ayfe demmanaw hinteko baanaw qopas, shin digetas.
Hessa gisho, oonika higges kiitetidi Xoossaa sinthan xillanaw danda7enna. Higgey asi ubbay nagarancho gideysa bessees.
Geeshsha Maxaafay, “Godaa sunthaa xeegiya oonika attana” yaagees.
Xoossaas tal7eynne tal7iya zaaridi ekey oonee?” yaagees.
